title: Top ten attributed groups: public endpoint pilot

selection.ranking: Largest attributed block counts in a frozen 2,016-block snapshot; unknown blocks remain in the share denominator. Attribution groups are not independently verified operators.

pools.name: AlphaPool
pools.scope: One published US public SV1 endpoint

pools.name: Lazarus
pools.scope: Public pool-operated gateway; separate own-gateway DATUM path not tested

pools.name: Bitcoin Xor
pools.scope: Public pool-operated gateway; separate own-gateway DATUM path not tested

pools.name: RATUM
pools.scope: Not probed: RATUM is an explorer attribution label. A current, unambiguous public SV1 endpoint and its relationship to this label need operator confirmation; gateway availability statements conflict with prior operator material.

pools.name: CONVOY
pools.scope: Published SV1 failover endpoint; primary own-gateway DATUM path not tested

pools.name: B2Pool
pools.scope: One published regional ASIC SV1 endpoint; DATUM and SV2 paths not tested

pools.name: RIPTIDE
pools.scope: Public SV1 endpoint; separate own-gateway DATUM path not tested

pools.name: Quai Network
pools.scope: Not probed: no operator-confirmed XBT endpoint linked to this explorer label. The name alone is insufficient to select a service.

pools.name: PyBLOCK
pools.scope: Published LOTTO SV1 endpoint only; does not represent all PyBLOCK services or establish linkage to every attributed block

pools.name: Mining-Dutch
pools.scope: Not probed: a complete current XBT host/port and permitted worker format were not established from the public page inspected. No account was created or credentials used.
